---
# Match the article ID and PDF filename suffix to the publication number.
# Enter article metadata here. Then update the matching cover fields below.
# Journal headers: PJ = header_police.PNG, CJ = header_corrections.PNG
# CT = header_courts.PNG, CS = header_communitysafety.PNG
# Change the header path in the cover block and the running journal name below.
title: "Article Title"
subtitle: "Optional subtitle"
author:
  - name: "First Last"
    affiliations:
      - name: "Author Affiliation"
date: "YYYY-MM-DD"
journal_name: "Journal Name"
submission_type: "Research & Education"
article_id: "XX-YYYY-NNN"
volume: 1
number: "000"
publication_year: YYYY
output-file: "XX-YYYY-NNN.pdf"
keywords: []

format:
  titlepage-pdf:
    documentclass: scrartcl
    pdf-engine: xelatex

    # Disable automatically generated title and cover pages.
    titlepage: false
    coverpage: false

    # Table of contents and section numbering
    toc: false
    lof: false
    lot: false
    number-sections: false

    # Hyperlinks
    colorlinks: true
    linkcolor: EPCLTerracotta
    urlcolor: EPCLTerracotta
    citecolor: EPCLTerracotta

    # Page dimensions
    geometry:
      - top=0.85in
      - bottom=0.85in
      - left=0.9in
      - right=0.9in

    fontsize: 11pt
    linestretch: 1.2

    include-in-header:
      text: |
        % =====================================================
        % COLORS
        % =====================================================

        \usepackage{xcolor}

        \definecolor{EPCLTerracotta}{HTML}{7A2E1D}
        \definecolor{EPCLCharcoal}{HTML}{263238}
        \definecolor{EPCLGold}{HTML}{B8862F}
        \definecolor{EPCLGray}{HTML}{667085}

        % =====================================================
        % TYPOGRAPHY
        % =====================================================

        \usepackage{fontspec}

        \setmainfont{Segoe UI}
        \setsansfont{Segoe UI}

        % =====================================================
        % SUPPORTING PACKAGES
        % =====================================================

        \usepackage{graphicx}
        \usepackage{microtype}
        \usepackage{booktabs}
        \usepackage{array}
        \usepackage{caption}
        \usepackage{setspace}
        \usepackage{fancyhdr}
        \usepackage{needspace}
        \usepackage{eso-pic}

        % =====================================================
        % SECTION TYPOGRAPHY
        % =====================================================

        \setkomafont{section}{
          \sffamily
          \Large
          \bfseries
          \color{EPCLCharcoal}
        }

        \setkomafont{subsection}{
          \sffamily
          \large
          \bfseries
          \color{EPCLCharcoal}
        }

        \setkomafont{subsubsection}{
          \sffamily
          \normalsize
          \bfseries
          \color{EPCLCharcoal}
        }

        % Section spacing
        \RedeclareSectionCommand[
          beforeskip=2.0ex plus 0.5ex minus 0.2ex,
          afterskip=1.0ex plus 0.2ex
        ]{section}

        \RedeclareSectionCommand[
          beforeskip=1.5ex plus 0.4ex minus 0.2ex,
          afterskip=0.7ex plus 0.2ex
        ]{subsection}

        % =====================================================
        % FIGURE AND TABLE CAPTIONS
        % =====================================================

        \captionsetup{
          font=small,
          labelfont=bf,
          justification=raggedright,
          singlelinecheck=false
        }

        % =====================================================
        % RUNNING HEADERS AND FOOTERS
        % =====================================================

        \pagestyle{fancy}

        \fancyhf{}

        \fancyhead[L]{
          \small\sffamily\textsc{Journal Name}
        }

        \fancyhead[R]{
          \small\sffamily\textsc{EPCL Publications}
        }

        \fancyfoot[C]{\thepage}

        \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.4pt}
        \renewcommand{\footrulewidth}{0pt}

        \setlength{\headheight}{15pt}

        % =====================================================
        % AUTHOR AND AFFILIATION FORMATTING
        % =====================================================

        \newcommand{\EPCLAuthor}[2]{%
          #1\textsuperscript{\normalfont #2}%
        }

        \newcommand{\EPCLAffiliation}[2]{%
          \noindent
          \hangindent=1.2em
          \hangafter=1
          \makebox[1.2em][l]{\textsuperscript{#1}}%
          #2\par
        }

execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
